population_backtest.limitations: Ex-post backtest on the currently downloaded historical population series, not archived as-of publisher releases. Revisions can change results. Training and held-out windows overlap, so errors are not independent trials. No confidence interval, calibrated forecast, transportation-demand forecast or future accuracy guarantee is implied.
population_backtest.basis: Five consecutive training years ending at each origin; targets one or three years later. Only pre-origin history is fitted. Last-observed-value forecast is the reference. No missing years are imputed.

road_activity.basis: Annual totals sum exactly 12 source-estimated calendar months. Miles per resident use the same-year US population; absent denominators remain null. Partial years are never annualized.
road_activity.limitations: Historical FHWA/FRED numeric archive through August 2023, not seasonally adjusted. Mirror retrieval is not source-release vintage. Estimates may have been revised since this archive. Combined passenger/freight road travel; no link, vehicle, commodity or OD detail. Miles per resident are aggregate road use, not an individual's travel.

commuting.limitations: Workers 16 years and over by residence and usual commuting means, including working from home. Five-year values are survey period estimates, not sums of five annual counts. Estimates are not observed trips, unique daily travelers, OD flows or current conditions. Margins of error are published 90% ACS margins in workers; share percentages are descriptive ratios with no derived margin. Category margins must not be added. Geography is the ACS 2023 reporting geography; no temporal boundary crosswalk is implied. No county total is inferred from this downloaded subset.

data_quality.basis: Observed annual records between each series' first and last available source year. Current inventories, estimates and forecasts are excluded.

quality_semantics: validated means schema, finite nonnegative numeric values, year and key checks passed. Source accuracy has not been independently verified. source_estimate marks upstream estimates, not internal forecasts. provisional marks experimental model output.

datasets.description: US annual GDP in current US dollars, World Bank indicator NY.GDP.MKTP.CD. Nominal values are not inflation adjusted.

datasets.description: Non-closed OurAirports facilities with source country US, grouped by recognized state/DC and facility type. datasets.name: Block-group commuting modes

County-wide completeness and publisher release date are unverified; no OD, trips or county totals are inferred.

coverage.name: Archived rail station points
coverage.detail: Washington metropolitan platform centroids; inventory date and service status unknown. Location assets, not dated observations, entrances, routes or current network coverage.

coverage.name: Block-group commuting survey
coverage.detail: 664 downloaded Montgomery County MD block groups, 2019–2023 ACS worker estimates and margins of error. Not county-wide verified coverage, annual traffic or OD flows.

coverage.name: National annual economy
coverage.detail: US population and nominal GDP; source-dependent annual history.

coverage.name: State airport inventory
coverage.detail: Current inventory counts, including heliports and small airfields; no traffic volumes.

coverage.name: Historical national road activity
coverage.detail: Monthly source-estimated vehicle miles, Jan 1970–Aug 2023 archive; complete-year totals and same-year population ratios. No current operations or link-level counts.

coverage.name: Experimental baseline forecasts
coverage.detail: Three-year linear population baseline; uncalibrated, no confidence intervals. Not a planning-grade forecast.

coverage.name: Links, corridors and origin–destination
coverage.detail: Road links, mode/commodity flows, live feeds and granular Census connectors are not yet integrated.
